scripted_turns: make a FigJam process of how a Fernhouse damaged-item refund moves between the customer, CS and the warehouse, on a new board in our Fernhouse Product plan, and highlight the handoff to the warehouse. From the support runbook: the customer reports damage with a photo through the help form. A CS agent checks the photo, approves clear damage on the spot and asks for a second photo when it is unclear. An approved claim goes to the warehouse queue, where an operator books a courier pickup, inspects the item on arrival and releases the refund. Every decision is logged in the claims table. Refunds under 20 euros skip the pickup, a pilot that is not yet live. The runbook also says: the help form asks for the order number, a photo and a short description. CS answers within one working day. The warehouse books the pickup for the next working day, and the inspection holds the item against the customer's photo. The refund goes back to the original payment method within 5 working days of the inspection.
